name: Starovice (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly by a dark red line into a white upper fly part and a green lower hoist part, with a dark red disc with a ring in the upper hoist.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 17 April 2009 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
